metadata.coverage_intent: The two original public ABI pointer classes exercise the callback-capture export's early Invalid_Argument guards. The fifty new c120 variants exercise null callback state and zero-document-pointer guards through an explicit public WASM safety extension. These are wrapper-boundary safety extensions, not claims that ordinary FreeType font bytes create invalid callback state; the maintained SVG font keeps every row tied to the public callback-capture surface.

fixture_requirements: The tracked OT-SVG font is retained on every row so the cases stay on the public renderer-capture operation; pointer probes return before ordinary font rendering. The four c120 state modes are explicit WASM safety-extension inputs, while pinned FreeType source review confirms that a normal renderer invocation supplies valid state and document pointers.
